[LTIM.2.1.3] Two calls to `now()` within one rule activation
must return the same value. Activations are atomic with respect
to the clock: the engine samples only between steps ([LTIM.2.8.4]), never
within an activation.
gap_reason: No conformance test pins activation-atomicity of the clock: nothing runs two `now()` reads of one activation with the source moved between them.

idris.name: iret_25_4_1__one_value_per_pump
idris.note: 'Two calls to `now()` within one rule activation must return the same value': every encounter of every firing in a pump sees the one held wall value, so any two of one activation agree.

idris.name: ltim_2_1_3__activation_atomic
idris.note: 'Activations are atomic with respect to the clock: the engine samples only between steps, never within an activation': any expression over the activation's clock reads is worth what the held sample makes it, whatever the order and the count of reads.
